title: Kobi <> Cedrick: Weekly Planning - 2026/08/31 11:30 EDT - Notes by Gemini
screen_reason: Jumpr-internal onboarding/planning 1:1 for a new developer on WagerTech. items.topic: First Wager Date field purpose
items.statement: A First Wager Date field was added to the signup. It records the date the player deposits/wagers, as proof (alongside the deposit and signup proofs) that payout requirements for the signup are met.
items.quote: Kobi Kunasekaran: ... there's this first wager date field that we added. Um the idea was that this was you know when when the player deposits the money that they got from way to play in the casino or whatever um they would record that date in here as proof that they've completed the requirements to get paid out for the sign up
items.note: Jumpr-internal meeting; the client was not present. Client asks are relayed by the Jumpr lead, not client-voiced evidence.

items.topic: Log Signup and Complete screen flows behavior
items.statement: There are two screen flows on the signup: Log Signup and Complete. In New status users only have Log Signup; saving moves the record to In Progress. Fields are not required in Log Signup but are all required in Complete, and saving Complete marks the signup Completed.
items.quote: Kobi Kunasekaran: We have two screen flows. There's one for log signup and one for complete. ... during the new new status u they only have access to log signup right and the expectation is that when they enter some value and click save it moves a record to in progress. ... So in the lock signup they're not required but in complete signup all of these are required
items.note: Jumpr-internal meeting; the client was not present. Client asks are relayed by the Jumpr lead, not client-voiced evidence.

items.topic: Story 243: Log Signup must require input

items.topic: Story 243: show screen instead of silent check
items.statement: The story 243 acceptance criteria said to compare field values before and after save and not move the status if nothing changed. Kobi and Cedrick agreed instead to show a follow-up screen telling the user to enter information to move the record to In Progress (the before/after check is still needed). Internal Jumpr build decision; client acceptance not shown.
items.quote: Kobi Kunasekaran: ... in the story actually the A I specified is like let's compare the value before and after of the fields that are in the signup and then if nothing is saved then or nothing has changed then don't move the status but now that like I'm talking about it I was also thinking the same thing we just display an error message instead or not an error message but like a follow-up / Kobi Kunasekaran: Let's let's go forward with throwing a screen that says enter some information to move this record to in progress. / Kobi Kunasekaran: It's okay. Let's do that. Let's do that. I like that idea actually.
items.supersedes_hint: Replaces the story's AC (silent before/after comparison, no status change) with an explicit follow-up/error screen. Story text not yet updated per the transcript.

items.topic: Player created Pending via SLC processing
items.statement: SLC processing finds an existing player by email or external ID, or creates a player record. New player records get status Pending by default (Kobi is unsure whether the flow sets it).
items.quote: Kobi Kunasekaran: ... Our SLC processing automation is going to either find a player that exists for that click based on email address or external ID. Um, if that player doesn't exist, then it's going to create a player record. And when it creates a player record, the status on the player record is set to pending um automatically.
items.note: Jumpr-internal meeting; the client was not present. Client asks are relayed by the Jumpr lead, not client-voiced evidence.
